datasets.name: Beichuan County landslide identification sample library
datasets.verbatim: A library of landslide identification samples was created using high-resolution remote sensing imagery and landslide boundary data obtained through field validation.

datasets.name: Google Earth images (0.5 m resolution)
datasets.verbatim: Using high-resolution Google Earth images with a spatial resolution of 0.5 m, combined with the spectral characteristics of landslides in the study area, we applied visual interpretation to construct landslide identification sample data.

datasets.name: Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: In order to verify the practical effectiveness of the DSNet proposed in this study, the publicly available landslide dataset [50] in Bijie, Guizhou, is used to carry out the adaptability analysis.

datasets.name: GVLM dataset
datasets.verbatim: In order to verify the generalizability of the DSNet, the publicly available GVLM dataset [51] is selected as the research subject in this study.

methods.name: Dual-Coded Segmentation Network (DS Net)
methods.summary: A dual-encoder single-decoder architecture that integrates prior knowledge features. It uses a Swin Transformer encoder for hierarchical feature extraction and a CLIP-based image encoder for visual-semantic understanding, fused via Prior Knowledge Integration (PKI) and Cross-Feature Aggregation (CFA) modules.
methods.verbatim: In this study, we propose a Dual-coded Segmentation Network (DSNet) that integrates prior knowledge features through a dual-encoder single-decoder architecture.

availability.author_statement: "The original contributions presented in the study are included in the article, further inquiries can be directed to the corresponding author."

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but not linked or made available, and the custom DSNet code is not provided or linked.
